actual: Unattended MiniQMT SIM submit still ran shadow A/B before submit and left compiler(B)/gray/env routing available. 2026-07-07 py-spy showed scheduler stuck in json.dumps via JsonFileMiniQMTExecutionRuntimeRepository._save while runtime-state.json had grown to 63.7MB / 114 runtimes / 24036 events / 3477 algo / 3478 child orders; submit/reconcile could also block the single scheduler thread.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description:
MiniQMT SIM must be A(event_loop)-only. Shadow A/B comparison and B compiler/gray routing are retired because B never successfully ran and A==B is not valid evidence.

P0 escalation 2026-07-07 09:25: scheduler thread froze in the MiniQMT submit/shadow/reconcile phase, so synchronous shadow must be deleted and submit/reconcile/binding stages must have loud timeouts/watchdog isolation.

P0 escalation 2026-07-07 py-spy: stack was json._iterencode_dict -> json.dumps -> repository.py _save -> upsert_algo_instance -> record_algo_instance -> _persist_vnpy_core_state -> record_trade_event -> _run_binding. Root cause was production default JsonFileMiniQMTExecutionRuntimeRepository, a Phase 2.1 temporary JSON store, performing O(full repository) serialization per runtime/event/algo/child write. Production must use a real Postgres MiniQMTExecutionRuntimeRepository with controlled forward/rollback DDL, incremental row writes, retention prune/archive, and no startup auto-migration. Existing tmp/miniqmt_execution_runtime/runtime-state.json is disposable; do not bulk import it into DB.

events.note: User supplied 2026-07-07 intraday evidence of scheduler freeze and 63MB runtime-state write amplification; expanded scope to repository watchdog/prune/reset.

User supplied py-spy root cause and production JSON write amplification evidence; scope expanded to MiniQMT runtime repository, client/gateway, controlled DDL migrations, watchdog tests, and affected Paper v2/MiniQMT regression tests.
Postgres runtime repository requires controlled production DDL after merge; no startup auto-migration, no production DB write, and no service restart are performed by this PR.

expected: MiniQMT SIM uses event_loop(A) only with the real qmt callback gateway; no shadow A/B payload/state, no gray switch, and no hidden compiler(B) fallback. Any forced B route or missing callback/precondition loudly rejects with reason_code + stage. Submit/reconcile and each binding tick are timeout-isolated so one hung binding cannot freeze the scheduler. Production runtime state persists to Postgres with incremental per-row writes, bounded prune/archive for events/algo_instances/child_orders, and JsonFile is test/offline only with no production fallback or runtime-state.json growth.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
Do not write production DB or apply production DDL in the fix PR.
Do not bulk import tmp/miniqmt_execution_runtime/runtime-state.json into Postgres; after DDL is applied and DB repository is verified, archive/delete the tmp JSON/JSONL store safely.
